delete2.title: Account data wipe — BLOCKED
delete2.body: A second attempt to erase all account data and backup was detected and automatically blocked.

witnessCall.title: Emergency Call
dispatch: Call received — housekeeper reports unusual lights and no answer at the victim's house

intro.title: Reconstruct the night through digital traces.
intro.summary: This guided kiosk walks you through the night of May 17, 2024. Cross-reference the victim's phone, conversations, cellular data and Google account activity — then decide what each suspect came to do.

briefing.stationGoals: 2. What this station is trying to show
briefing.step1Body: The phone was placed inside a Faraday container right after recovery. This shielded enclosure blocks all wireless signals so the device cannot be tracked, accessed or wiped remotely.
briefing.step2Body: Four sources will be cross-referenced: the victim's phone, their conversations, the cellular network triangulation, and the Google account activity.
briefing.step3Body: Use timing across these electronic sources to figure out when each suspect was at the victim's house, and what conversations led up to the visit.
briefing.step4Body: You decide why each suspect came over. The system shows the traces — the interpretation is yours.

header.title: Rebuild the night through converging traces

context.title: Current source
context.defaultBody: Start from the crime scene and reveal one evidence layer at a time. The map and right panel change together so the logic stays readable in a few seconds.
defaultPoints: Victim's Phone explains recovery and forensic handling.
Cellular Network compares physical presence and movement.
Google Account explains the blocked deletion attempts.
Conversations reveal motive, witness timing, and ambiguity.
context.guideTitle: Reveal the evidence in four steps

phone.heading: Recovered, transported, and cloned for analysis
phone.summary: The device leaves the house under chain of custody and is protected before any attacker can successfully wipe it.
evidence: Messages, call logs, and contacts remain available in the forensic copy.
The transport path from the house to Commissariat Central is confirmed.
The phone is isolated before the attacker can complete remote deletion.

google.heading: Remote deletion fails after the account is accessed
google.statusTitle: Remote access blocked - device isolation successful
google.statusBody: The account is accessed from Karim's area in Hassan district just after 7am, but the phone is already inside the Faraday container and unreachable for a remote wipe.

conversations.heading: Message threads reveal motive and invitations
conversations.summary: The housekeeper flags an early-morning anomaly, Karim is upset about the deal but invited in, and Samir comes over drunk despite being told not to.
conversations.witnessBody: The housekeeper arrives early, notices the lights at 5:48am, tries calling, then calls the police at 6:30am.
witnessPoints: Works regularly at the victim's house and arrives before dawn.
Notices unusual lights before dawn and texts the victim.
Calls the police at 6:30am, before the phone is secured.

cellular.heading: Triangulation places both men near the victim that night
cellular.compareBody: Telecom metadata places both men near the victim. Karim leaves around 5am, Samir around 6:30am — right when the housekeeper calls the police.
towers: Tower B: Central overlap near the victim
Tower C: Hassan side toward Karim's last known area

karim.title: Karim movement
karim.summary: Karim's device moves from Hassan district toward the victim's house in the evening, stays through the night, and leaves around 5am back toward Hassan.
points: Arrival is consistent with the invited visit.
Stays through the early night hours.
Leaves around 5:00am, before the housekeeper's call.

samir.title: Samir movement
samir.summary: Samir travels from his home in Agdal to the victim's area despite being told not to, and only leaves around 6:30am.
points: Arrives despite Youssef's refusal.
Stays the longest of the two suspects.
Leaves around 6:30am, just as the housekeeper calls the police.

timeline.heading: All traces support the same sequence
timeline.summary: The full sequence connects the early-morning alert, the two visits, the cellular triangulation and the blocked remote deletion chain.
timeline.resultBody: Karim came after an argument and was invited in. Samir came drunk and was not invited. The Google login from Karim's area happens just after 7am, after the phone is already in the Faraday container.

timeline.title: Build the complete sequence
timeline.summary: Once all evidence sources are revealed, the timeline aligns physical presence with digital behavior.

conclusion.title: Two suspects entered the house — you decide why.
conclusion.summary: The system shows the digital traces: phone evidence, conversations, cellular triangulation and Google account activity. The interpretation is yours.
conclusion.quote: Karim came after an argument and was invited in. Samir came drunk and was not invited. It's up to you to decide.

phone.title: Victim's Phone
phone.body: Recovered at the crime scene, the device is transported to Commissariat Central de Rabat and cloned for forensic analysis.
points: Recovered at the victim's home in the Medina district.
Moved under police control to a real forensic anchor location.
Messages, call logs, and contacts remain available in the copy.

cellular.title: Cellular Network
cellular.body: Cell tower triangulation places both men near the victim's house. Karim leaves around 5am, Samir around 6:30am.
points: Both Samir and Karim can be placed near the house overnight.
Departure times anchor the morning sequence.
Spatial correlation strengthens the reconstruction.

google.title: Google Account
google.body: A new login appears from Karim's area just after 7am, followed by two failed attempts to remotely erase the phone.
points: 07:24 login from Hassan district.
07:26 deletion attempt blocked.
07:29 second deletion attempt blocked.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.body: Threads with the housekeeper, Karim and Samir reveal motive, invitations and the early-morning alert.
points: Housekeeper flags an early-morning anomaly and calls the police.
Karim is upset about the deal but Youssef invites him over.
Samir is drunk, told 'NO, not tonight', and comes over anyway.

timeline.title: Correlation Timeline
timeline.body: The final timeline combines the night-of-incident messages, the cellular departures, the housekeeper's call and the blocked remote deletion attempts.
points: Karim is invited and arrives.
Samir comes uninvited, drunk.
The blocked deletion chain happens after the phone is in the Faraday box.

karim.title: Karim
karim.body: Upset about a drug deal, says he is coming over. Youssef invites him in to talk it out. Leaves the house around 5am, before the police are called.
points: Conversation shows tension, then an explicit invitation.
Cellular pings place him at the house overnight.
Google login from his area happens just after 7am.

samir.title: Samir
samir.body: Drunk, still upset about a girl from the previous week, told 'NO, not tonight' but came over anyway. Leaves around 6:30am, around when the housekeeper calls the police.
points: Old grievance about a shared interest.
Drunk and insistent the night of the incident.
Morning-after messages show memory gaps.
